title: Owner: create the voidbrain/bricks library repository
goal: The owner creates the voidbrain/bricks repository (Bricks 🧱, Angular library @voidbrain/bricks; name decided 2026-11-25) and chooses its visibility and how it publishes
acceptance: Name decided 2026-11-25: Bricks, emoji 🧱, repository voidbrain/bricks, Angular library package @voidbrain/bricks; the owner chooses visibility and publishing (GitHub Packages npm or Git tags) and creates the repository; web components only if a non-Angular consumer appears
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one decision on the options T03 writes down. Not a measurement.
